item.title: Suspect identified in Austin bar shooting that left 2 dead, 14 injured; probe into terrorism continues
item.description: Investigators have identified the man accused of opening fire outside a busy downtown Austin bar early Sunday, killing at least two people and injuring 14 others, in an attack now under federal review for possible terrorism links.

item.title: Officials at the USG plant in Sperry have announced the recipient of this year’s Community Foundation Grant
item.description: Officials at the USG plant in Sperry have announced the recipient of this year’s Community Foundation Grant. The $5,000 grant is going to the Southeast Iowa Resource Center, a regional nonprofit that supports communities across Southeast Iowa.
